name: Gluten Free Orange Cupcakes
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 110 g wheat-free and gluten-free plain flour
finely grated zest of an orange

steps: Preheat oven to 180 C/Gas 4 and place muffin paper cases in a large 12 cup muffin tin.
Beat butter and sugar to a cream and then beat in eggs.
Sieve flours with baking powder and stir in along with ground almonds and orange zest.
Bake for 15 -25 minutes until golden and cooked.
Cool on a wire rack and ice if desired when cold.
Comments: Makes 12 cupcakes (one and a half inch high muffin cases) or 24 small ones.
Lemon may be substituted for orange if desired.

culture.text: A cupcake, fairy cake (BrE), patty cake (AuE), or bun (IrE) is a small cake designed to serve one person, which may be baked in a small thin paper or aluminum cup. As with larger cakes, frosting, icing and various other cake decorations such as fruit and candy may be applied.
